⚠️ Top 4 Execution Headwinds
1. Lunar Lake Packaging Gross Margin Drag: Outsourced wafer fabrication and on-package memory packaging dilute Client gross margins until internal 18A Panther Lake ramps in 2027.

3. Fierce Server Competition from AMD Turin: AMD Zen 5 EPYC Turin continues to exert intense pricing and socket competition in tier-1 hyperscaler cloud procurement.
4. Gaudi 3 Enterprise AI Software Friction: Nvidia CUDA dominance and developer tooling stickiness continue to present hurdles for broad commercial adoption of Gaudi 3 AI accelerators.

Bull Case Framing: Intel 18A remains on track with healthy defect density progression; external packaging and wafer pipeline expands following commitments from AWS and Microsoft; Panther Lake tape-outs validate internal silicon execution.

Bear Case Framing: High initial wafer scrap rates and packaging yield friction could delay volume ramps, while tier-1 fabless giants (Apple, Nvidia, Qualcomm) continue exclusively using TSMC N3/N2 without signing commercial 18A wafer purchase orders.

Bull Case Framing: Enterprise Copilot+ PC refresh cycle drives rapid Client Computing (CCPG) revenue expansion to $8.8B+, while next-generation Panther Lake brings memory back off-package and fab in-house, expanding gross margins by 400+ bps.

Analyst Call Focus: Can management quantify the gross margin impact of Lunar Lake packaging costs in Q3 and confirm the margin expansion roadmap as Client products transition to internal 18A silicon?

DEBATE-03: Data Center & AI (DCAI) Server Share Defense vs AMD Turin & Gaudi 3 Ramp
